subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summery: The Battle of Plassey in 1757 led to British rule in India, resulting in the defeat of Nawab Sirajuddaula. In 1763, Meer Kashim tried to bring back the freedom of Bengal but failed. Robert Clive had been the governor of Bengal for two times. The British rulers, having Warren Hastings, made the Nawab powerless. Lord Cornwallis tried to make settlement of land as a governor. The people of Bengal were exploited and oppressed inhumanly in their own land by the British rulers. Finally, we achieved our freedom in 1971 through a bloody war.
